# AGT-CTL-01

**Are step, cost and time limits set, and is there a kill switch that works without the agent's cooperation?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | CTL: Control and accountability |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
